bullets.section: One of the best hotel experiences I’ve ever had —
bullets.title: Hotel Emma in San Antonio
bullets.note: Trust me. Take a look at it. I recently stayed in SA at “The Emma” on a Wednesday night (backyard Latin music session, plus live jazz in the bar, etc.) after several world travelers recommended it. I was skeptical… and walked away stunned by the attention to detail in nearly every aspect of the hotel, restaurants, and surrounding fun.

bullets.title: ‘Not my circus. Not my monkeys.’ - Polish proverb — My favorite daily reminder in my kitchen.

“My great religion is a belief in the blood, the flesh, as being wiser than the intellect. We can go wrong in our minds. But what our blood feels and believes and says, is always true. The intellect is only a bit and a bridle. What do I care about knowledge. All I want is to answer to my blood, direct, without fribbling intervention of mind, or moral, or what not.” — D. H. Lawrence [](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/wvunxemrragh3owk0/xlhph6h76799l/aHR0cHM6Ly9lbi53aWtpcGVkaWEub3JnL3dpa2kvUmFqbmVlc2g=) [](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/wvunxemrragh3owk0/5xuvh7h989kk5/aHR0cHM6Ly9lbi53aWtpcGVkaWEub3JnL3dpa2kvTWFlX1dlc3Q=) And, as always, please give me feedback on Twitter.
